arl_token.label: ARL token
arl_token.description: Your Deezer ARL cookie token. When changing these settings later, leave it empty to keep the token you already saved. See https://www.dumpmedia.com/deezplus/deezer-arl.html

family_profile.label: Deezer profile
family_profile.description: The profile of your Deezer Family whose library this source uses.

explicit_content.label: Explicit content
explicit_content.description: Hide tracks, podcasts and audiobooks Deezer marks as explicit. 'Follow Deezer account setting' uses the explicit content setting of this account or profile on deezer.com, read when this source starts. Hidden tracks are also refused at playback, so they cannot be played from a shared playlist either.

hide_explicit_albums.label: Hide explicit albums too
hide_explicit_albums.description: Also hide albums Deezer marks as explicit, instead of showing them without their explicit tracks. Deezer marks an album explicit when any of its tracks is, so this hides the clean tracks of those albums from the album view as well. A separate clean version of an album stays visible.

profile.title: Choose a profile
profile.description: This ARL belongs to a Deezer Family. Pick the profile this source should use. To use several profiles, add Deezer once for each of them.

manifest.description: Stream Deezer’s full music catalogue in CD-quality (FLAC) audio.

errors.no_subscription: This Deezer account has no subscription that Music Assistant can stream from. Deezer Free accounts are not supported; check that the subscription on this specific account is still active.
errors.arl_rejected: Could not authenticate with Deezer using this ARL token. Try again and check that the token is current. See the Music Assistant log for details.
errors.gw_no_session: Deezer authenticated this account but could not establish a playback session. Try again. If the problem persists, see the Music Assistant log for details.
errors.auth_failed: Could not sign in to Deezer. See the Music Assistant log for the reason reported by Deezer.
